Code for the data slides only. Everything reads the files made by `respo_LoLinR.R` and `respo_rates_plots.R`; nothing here re-runs LoLinR.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)

SampleMeta <- read_csv(here("data", "mpw_sample_meta.csv"))                                   # one row per sample: field data
RespoMeta  <- read_csv(here("data", "respirometry", "mpw", "mpw_respo_meta.csv"))             # respo times, notes, exclude
RespoR_PR  <- read_csv(here("data", "respirometry", "mpw", "processed", "mpw_PnR_rates.csv")) # rates from respo_rates_plots.R

# samples left out = anything with text in the "exclude" column (O2 rose in the dark, or probe failure)
excluded <- RespoMeta %>% filter(!is.na(exclude)) %>% distinct(sample_ID, exclude)

# one row per kept sample, with Respiration, NetPhoto, GrossPhoto as columns + all field data
rates_wide <- RespoR_PR %>%
  filter(!sample_ID %in% excluded$sample_ID) %>%
  select(sample_ID, PR, Values) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = PR, values_from = Values) %>%
  left_join(SampleMeta, by = "sample_ID") %>%
  filter(habitat != "blank")

# zones and colours used on slides 16-19
zone_levels <- c("lagoon_south", "lagoon_north", "cove", "ocean")
zone_colors <- c(lagoon_south = "#D55E00", lagoon_north = "#E69F00", cove = "#0072B2", ocean = "#009E73")
zone_labels <- c(lagoon_south = "Lagoon S", lagoon_north = "Lagoon N", cove = "Cove", ocean = "Ocean")

rates_wide <- rates_wide %>% mutate(zone = factor(subzone, levels = zone_levels))
field <- SampleMeta %>%
  filter(sample_type == "sample") %>%                         # all 115 samples (no respo exclusions)
  mutate(zone = factor(subzone, levels = zone_levels),
         lat = parse_number(as.character(planned_lat)),
         lon = parse_number(as.character(planned_lon)))

rate_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(PR = factor(PR, levels = c("Respiration", "NetPhoto", "GrossPhoto"),
                            labels = c("Respiration", "Net photosynthesis", "Gross photosynthesis")))
}
```

## Slide 12: all LoLinR diagnostic plots

Run once by hand; takes about 30 s. Saves the images in `output/mpw/respirometry/`.

```{r}
#| label: lolinr-montage
#| eval: false
library(magick)   # install.packages(c("magick", "pdftools")) the first time
respo_dir <- here("output", "mpw", "respirometry")

make_montage <- function(pdf_files, out_file, columns) {
  pages <- map(pdf_files, function(f) {
    image_read_pdf(f, density = 40) %>%
      image_annotate(str_remove(basename(f), "\\.pdf$"), size = 14, gravity = "north", boxcolor = "white")
  })
  image_join(pages) %>%
    image_montage(tile = paste0(columns, "x"), geometry = "+2+2") %>%
    image_write(out_file, format = "jpg", quality = 80)
}

all_files <- unlist(map(paste0("D", 1:6), ~ list.files(file.path(respo_dir, .x), pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)))
make_montage(all_files, file.path(respo_dir, "LoLinR_all_days.jpg"), columns = 16)
```

## Slides 13-14: one LoLinR diagnostic plot

These are made inside the loop in `respo_LoLinR.R` (shown, not run here).

```{r}
#| label: lolinr-key-lines
#| eval: false
# 1. cut each raw O2 file to its dark or light window (start/stop times from mpw_respo_meta.csv)
data <- Respo.Data1 %>%
  filter(Time >= start_time & Time <= stop_time) %>%
  arrange(Time) %>%
  mutate(t_sec = as.numeric(difftime(Time, first(Time), units = "secs"))) %>%
  filter(t_sec > acclim_sec) %>%                  # drop acclimation (1800 s = 30 min; D5 = 0)
  filter(row_number() %% thin_n == 0)             # keep every 10th row (D1, D2, D4) or 20th (D3, D5, D6)

# 2. LoLinR finds the most linear stretch of the O2 trace (Olito et al. 2017)
fit <- rankLocReg(xall = data$t_sec, yall = data$Value, alpha = 0.2, method = "pc")

# 3. the 6-panel diagnostic plot on slides 13-14
plot(fit)

# 4. slope (umol O2 / L / s) -> rate per chamber (umol O2 / hr), in respo_rates_plots.R
umol.hr <- umol.L.sec * (volume_mL * 0.001) * 3600   # chamber volume 473 mL
# Respiration = -(dark slope); Net photosynthesis = light slope; Gross photosynthesis = Net + Respiration
```

## Slide 15: rates by habitat and distance to SGD

```{r}
#| label: slide15-habitat
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 9
sgd_cutoff_m <- 10   # lagoon samples closer than this to an SGD zone or seep = "near_SGD", the rest = "T"

RespoR_PR %>%
  left_join(SampleMeta %>% select(sample_ID, habitat, dist_to_sgd_m), by = "sample_ID") %>%
  filter(habitat != "blank", !sample_ID %in% excluded$sample_ID) %>%
  mutate(habitat_sgd = case_when(habitat == "lagoon" & dist_to_sgd_m <  sgd_cutoff_m ~ "near_SGD",
                                 habitat == "lagoon" & dist_to_sgd_m >= sgd_cutoff_m ~ "T",
                                 habitat == "cove"  ~ "C",
                                 habitat == "ocean" ~ "O"),
         habitat_sgd = factor(habitat_sgd, levels = c("near_SGD", "T", "C", "O"))) %>%
  rate_labels() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = habitat_sgd, y = Values)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = run_block), width = 0.12, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~PR, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = paste0("near_SGD = tidepool < ", sgd_cutoff_m, " m from SGD, T = rest of tidepool, C = cove, O = ocean"),
       y = expression(paste(mu, "mol O"[2], " hr"^-1)), color = "Day") +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Slides 15-16: median rates table and lagoon vs outside test

```{r}
#| label: median-table
rates_wide %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = c("lagoon", "cove", "ocean"))) %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(c(Respiration, NetPhoto, GrossPhoto),
                   ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", median(.x), quantile(.x, 0.25), quantile(.x, 0.75)))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Median (interquartile range), umol O2/hr")

tibble(rate = c("Respiration", "NetPhoto", "GrossPhoto")) %>%
  mutate(p_value = map_dbl(rate, ~ wilcox.test(rates_wide[[.x]] ~ (rates_wide$habitat == "lagoon"))$p.value),
         p_value = signif(p_value, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Lagoon vs outside (Wilcoxon rank-sum test)")
```

## Slide 17: oxygen, pH and salinity against each other

```{r}
#| label: slide17-field-chemistry
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 12
pair_plot <- function(x, y, xlab, ylab) {
  ggplot(field, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], color = zone)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Zone")
}
wrap_plots(pair_plot("salinity", "pH", "Salinity", "pH"),
           pair_plot("salinity", "DO_pct", "Salinity", "DO (% sat)"),
           pair_plot("pH", "DO_pct", "pH", "DO (% sat)"),
           nrow = 1, guides = "collect")

# how strongly pH and oxygen follow salinity in the lagoon (Spearman rank correlation)
lagoon_field <- field %>% filter(habitat == "lagoon")
tibble(variable = c("pH", "DO_pct")) %>%
  mutate(rho = map_dbl(variable, ~ cor(lagoon_field[[.x]], lagoon_field$salinity, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
         p_value = map_dbl(variable, ~ cor.test(lagoon_field[[.x]], lagoon_field$salinity, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value)) %>%
  mutate(rho = round(rho, 2), p_value = format.pval(p_value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Lagoon: correlation with salinity")
```

## Slide 18: seep maps

```{r}
#| label: slide18-maps
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
shapes <- read_csv(here("data", "gps", "mpw_map_shapes.csv"))   # pool, SGD zones and seeps from MPW_map.kmz

map_one <- function(var, label) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = filter(shapes, type == "pool"), aes(lon, lat, group = name), fill = "grey95", color = "grey50") +
    geom_polygon(data = filter(shapes, type == "sgd"),  aes(lon, lat, group = name), fill = NA, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = filter(shapes, type == "seep"), aes(lon, lat), shape = 4, size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = field %>% filter(habitat == "lagoon", !is.na(.data[[var]])),
               aes(lon, lat, color = .data[[var]]), size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1, name = label) +   # low values = bright yellow
    coord_quickmap() +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = label)
}

wrap_plots(map_one("salinity", "Salinity"), map_one("pH", "pH"),
           map_one("DO_pct", "DO (% sat)"), map_one("temp_C", "Temp (deg C)"), ncol = 2)
```

## Slide 19: P:R ratio and starting oxygen by zone

```{r}
#| label: slide19-pr-and-oxygen
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 10
# P:R = gross photosynthesis / respiration; above 1 = makes more O2 than it uses
pr_data <- rates_wide %>% mutate(PR_ratio = GrossPhoto / Respiration)
sum(pr_data$GrossPhoto <= 0)   # samples with gross P <= 0 can't go on a log scale, so they are left out

p_ratio <- pr_data %>%
  filter(GrossPhoto > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = PR_ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  zone_box + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "P:R (gross P / R, log scale)", title = "P:R ratio")

# starting oxygen = DO % measured on each sample (Orion) before incubation, all 115 samples
p_do <- field %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = zone, y = DO_pct)) +
  zone_box +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "DO (% saturation)", title = "Starting oxygen")

wrap_plots(p_ratio, p_do, nrow = 1)
```

### Groundwater fingerprint in the field data

Uses the field readings from **all 115 samples** (no respirometry exclusions). Groundwater is fresher, and here it also comes with lower pH and lower oxygen.

```{r}
#| label: groundwater-fingerprint
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 9
SampleMeta %>%
  filter(sample_type == "sample", !is.na(salinity)) %>%
  mutate(habitat = factor(habitat, levels = c("lagoon", "cove", "ocean"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(pH, DO_pct), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = recode(variable, pH = "pH", DO_pct = "Dissolved oxygen (% sat)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = salinity, y = value, color = habitat)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reverse() +                                   # fresher water on the right
  scale_color_manual(values = c(lagoon = "#D55E00", cove = "#0072B2", ocean = "#009E73")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = "Salinity (fresher water to the right)", y = NULL, color = "Habitat") +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Wave dats v still

Split by median lagoon salinity was below 34.5. If the lagoon responds on groundwater days but the outside water does not, that points toward groundwater rather than the pool itself.

```{r}
#| label: groundwater-days
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 10
gw_days <- SampleMeta %>%
  filter(habitat == "lagoon") %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarise(lagoon_salinity = median(salinity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(lagoon_salinity < 34.5) %>%
  pull(day)
gw_days   # which days counted as groundwater days

rates_wide %>%
  mutate(where = if_else(habitat == "lagoon", "Lagoon", "Outside (cove + ocean)"),
         day_type = if_else(day %in% gw_days, "Fresher", "Saltier")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Respiration, NetPhoto, GrossPhoto), names_to = "PR", values_to = "Values") %>%
  mutate(PR = factor(PR, levels = c("Respiration", "NetPhoto", "GrossPhoto"),
                     labels = c("Respiration", "Net photosynthesis", "Gross photosynthesis"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = where, y = Values, fill = day_type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.7), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~PR, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fresher" = "#E69F00", "Saltier" = "grey85")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.4, 0.8)) +                  # zoom in; a few extreme points are off the top/bottom
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(paste(mu, "mol O"[2], " hr"^-1)), fill = NULL) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

### Why were some days fresher?

Groundwater signal showed up on Days 1, 4 and 5 but not 2, 3 and 6, and it did not follow the tide. Field notes point to **waves**: small surf on fresh days, bigger surf on salty days. Wave overwash pushes seawater into the pool and flushes out the groundwater. *To test: Waimea Bay wave buoy and nearby rain gauge, ~Sept 28–Oct 6.*

### By tide and time collected

Tide height at the moment each sample was collected, estimated from the day's high and low tides in `data/mpw_tides.csv`. Tide changed by less than 0.2ft over sampling period so Day and Tide are effectively the same variable.

```{r}
#| label: tide-height
# tide table: one row per high or low tide
tides <- read_csv(here("data", "mpw_tides.csv")) %>%
  mutate(when = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  arrange(when)

# estimate tide height at any time, between the high/low before it and the one after it
tide_at <- function(t) {
  t <- as.numeric(t); w <- as.numeric(tides$when); h <- tides$tide_height_ft
  i <- findInterval(t, w)                       # which high/low came just before
  f <- (t - w[i]) / (w[i + 1] - w[i])           # fraction of the way to the next one (0 to 1)
  h[i] + (h[i + 1] - h[i]) * (1 - cos(pi * f)) / 2
}

rates_wide <- rates_wide %>%
  mutate(collected = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time_collected), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
         tide_height = tide_at(collected))

# tide range sampled each day
rates_wide %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarise(first_sample = format(min(collected, na.rm = TRUE), "%H:%M"),
            last_sample  = format(max(collected, na.rm = TRUE), "%H:%M"),
            tide_low_ft  = round(min(tide_height, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            tide_high_ft = round(max(tide_height, na.rm = TRUE), 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Tide height (ft) while sampling each day")
```
